body:
Toy needs a verifiable control CLI and local prerequisites before protected runtime admission. This draft builds the R0 kitchen and public control interfaces, fixes macOS identity bootstrap, and adds source-bound CLI fixtures for auth, research, quota accounting, queue behavior and control-file denials.

Bootstrap accepts macOS Application Support's admin group, uses pwpolicy -authentication-allowed for disabled accounts, and parses native IsHidden attributes and wrapped dscl values. CLI regressions cover all three failures; doctor observes all eight canonical identities. Memory admission uses free + inactive + purgeable + speculative pages, normal pressure, and each job's declared need plus 512 MiB. TypeScript/Python generation and compilation are enabled; Swift remains deferred to R3.

Research checks now derive Client and Activity requirements from README and the register's consuming-spec aliases, including shared components and the distinction between a Sources inventory ID and an Activity consumer. Existing Ops/LifeStore requirements remain additive. The owner also checks all 17 ADHD feature traces, quote/grill namespaces, primary evidence and register/release/acceptance links. Missing or unsupported records stay blocked. Native compatibility, authenticated research receipts and protected component activation remain separate gates.

Other included R0 behavior covers exact auth-pool refresh ownership and persistence, bounded research output receipts, role/model/skill routing, durable pending model admission and quota replay, a single cadence owner/read-only projection, source-build inventory and native PostgreSQL artifact inspection. The registered feature map links these interfaces to their source and assigned proof.

Validation:

- npm run check passes 409 generated artifacts, 341 contracts, 51 CLI manifests, 107 features, 55 commands and 1447 indexed ATs.
- The Client/Activity regressions reproduce six mapping failures against the unchanged owner, then pass 16 assigned and 195 affected checks across 12 groups on the first implementation run. Exact manifest and persisted run/show bindings are saved in build/evidence/R0.08/client-activity-final-verification.json.
- Both disposable worlds are completely down, with zero unresolved resources. Nine source/generated/map pins and all six queued root payload pins remain exact.
- Earlier bounded auth, accounting, cadence, inventory and research proofs remain in build/evidence/. Diagnostic PASS is distinct from whole-AT/card/release acceptance; all current fixture envelopes remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED/complete=false.

Claude staged the frozen root-owned runtime. ROOT-R004-20261006-02 is pending for actual UID 310 import/native Keychain read and exact restoration; ROOT-R005-20261006-01 is pending for native control-file denials. Valid R004-02 completion prioritizes R0.01. Protected runtime admission, complete R0–R5 acceptance, deployment and the actual 168-hour trial remain pending. The goal stays active while independent work continues.
